name: Driftaway on Dundas
signature: Three self-contained villas on 2.5 acres of tea-tree near Rye beach — breakfast hampers, oversized spa baths, one disability-accessible villa
editorNote:
Three self-contained villas on 2.5 acres of tea-tree near Rye beach. Breakfast hampers and oversized spa baths in each villa; one disability-accessible villa. Quieter than the hinterland B&B set, and positioned for guests whose preference is bay proximity over wine-country walking distance.

Confirm current rates, minimum stay, and dog policy directly — the pack notes these as unverified as of May 2026.
whyWeGo: Tea-tree setting near Rye beach, spa baths included, one accessible villa — the bay-side B&B option with the most complete amenity set.
ifOnlyOneThing: Confirm all three: rates, minimum stay, and dog policy before booking.
